description.zh:
云产品名称缩写。

关于如何获取云产品名称缩写，请参见[DescribeProjectMeta](~~114916~~)接口的返回参数`Labels`中的`metricCategory`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

For information about how to obtain the abbreviation, see the `metricCategory` tag in the `Labels` response parameter of the [DescribeProjectMeta](~~114916~~) operation.

description.zh: 报警联系组。
description.en: The alert contact group.

description.zh:
应用分组中报警规则的第一级维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：`{"userId":"120886317861****"}`和`{"instanceId":"i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr4****"}`。
description.en:
The first-level dimensions of the alert rule in the application group.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs, such as `{"userId":"120886317861****"}` and `{"instanceId":"i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr4****"}`.

description.zh: 报警规则的生效时间范围。
description.en: The effective period during which the alert rule takes effect.

description.zh: 报警邮件主题。
description.en: The subject of the alert email.

description.zh:
Critical级别阈值比较符。取值：

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold：大于等于。
- GreaterThanThreshold：大于。
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold：小于等于。
- LessThanThreshold：小于。
- NotEqualToThreshold：不等于。
- GreaterThanYesterday：同比昨天时间上涨。
- LessThanYesterday：同比昨天时间下降。
- GreaterThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间上涨。
- LessThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间下降。
- GreaterThanLastPeriod：环比上周期上涨。
- LessThanLastPeriod：环比上周期下降。
description.en:
The comparison operator for Critical-level alerts. Valid values:

- GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold.
- LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to the threshold.
- LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold.
- NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to the threshold.
- GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the value at the same time yesterday.
- LessThanYesterday: less than the value at the same time yesterday.
- GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the value at the same time last week.
- LessThanLastWeek: less than the value at the same time last week.
- GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the value in the last period.
- LessThanLastPeriod: less than the value in the last period.

description.zh:
Critical级别报警统计方法。多个统计方法之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

该参数的取值由指定云产品的`MetricName`对应的`Statistics`列决定，例如：Maximum、Minimum和Average。关于如何获取该参数的取值，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The statistical method for Critical-level alerts. Separate multiple statistical methods with commas (,).

The value of this parameter is determined by the `Statistics` column that corresponds to the `MetricName` of the specified Alibaba Cloud service, such as Maximum, Minimum, and Average. For information about how to obtain the value, see [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

description.zh: Critical级别报警阈值。
description.en: The threshold for Critical-level alerts.

description.zh: Critical级别报警重试次数。
description.en: The retry count for Critical-level alerts.

description.en: The threshold for Warn-level alerts.

description.zh: Warn级别报警重试次数。
description.en: The retry count for Warn-level alerts.

description.zh:
应用分组中报警规则的第二级或第三级维度。

格式：`key:value`键值对形式的集合，例如：`port:80`、`/dev/xvda:d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu****`。

当报警规则的第一级维度为`{"instanceId":"i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr4****"}`时，其第二级维度为该实例中的云盘`{"/dev/xvda":"d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu****"}`。
description.en:
The second-level or third-level dimensions of the alert rule in the application group.

Format: a collection of `key:value` pairs, such as `port:80` and `/dev/xvda:d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu****`.

If the first-level dimension is `{"instanceId":"i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr4****"}`, the second-level dimension is the cloud disk of the instance: `{"/dev/xvda":"d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu****"}`.

description.zh:
应用分组ID。

关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见[DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~)。
description.en:
The application group ID.

For information about how to obtain the application group ID, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

description.zh:
报警规则的探测周期。单位：秒。

> 建议报警规则的探测周期和数据上报周期保持一致。如果报警规则的探测周期小于数据上报周期，会因为数据不足而不能触发报警。
description.en:
The detection period of the alert rule. Unit: seconds.

> Keep the detection period consistent with the data reporting period. If the detection period is shorter than the data reporting period, alerts may not be triggered due to insufficient data.

description.zh:
报警规则标签。

报警通知中会包含标签。
description.en:
The tags of the alert rule.

Tags are included in alert notifications.

description.zh: 报警规则的标签键。
description.en: The tag key of the alert rule.

description.zh: 报警规则的标签值。
description.en: The tag value of the alert rule.

description.zh:
监控项名称。

关于如何获取监控项名称，请参见[DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~)或[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The metric name.

For information about how to obtain the metric name, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
云产品的命名空间。

关于如何获取云产品的命名空间，请参见[DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~)或[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the namespace, see [DescribeMetricMetaList](~~98846~~) or [Cloud service monitoring](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
无监控数据时报警的处理方式。取值：
- KEEP_LAST_STATE（默认值）：不做任何处理。
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA：报警内容为无数据。
- OK：正常。
description.en:
The processing method when no monitoring data is found. Valid values:
- KEEP_LAST_STATE (default): No action is performed.
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: An alert whose content is "Insufficient Data" is triggered.
- OK: The status is considered normal.

description.zh: 报警规则的失效时间范围。
description.en: The time range during which the alert rule is ineffective.

description.zh:
高级设置。

格式：{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}，例如：{"NotSendOK":true}，表示是否发送报警恢复通知，key为NotSendOK，value为true（不发送）或false（默认发送）。
description.en:
The advanced settings.

Format: {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}. Example: {"NotSendOK":true}. This specifies whether to send alert recovery notifications. The key is NotSendOK, and the value is true (do not send) or false (send, which is the default).

description.zh:
监控数据的上报周期。

`Period`的取值为60或60的整数倍。单位：秒。默认值：300。
description.en:
The reporting period of monitoring data.

The value of `Period` is 60 or a multiple of 60. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300.

description.zh:
报警规则ID。

- 当您为该应用分组创建报警规则时，直接输入报警规则ID。

- 当您修改该应用分组中的指定报警规则时，需要获取报警规则ID。关于如何获取报警规则ID，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en:
The alert rule ID.

- To create an alert rule for the application group, enter the alert rule ID.

- To modify a specified alert rule in the application group, obtain the alert rule ID. For information about how to obtain the alert rule ID, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

description.zh:
报警规则名称。

- 当您为该应用分组创建报警规则时，直接输入报警规则名称。

- 当您修改该应用分组中的指定报警规则时，需要获取报警规则名称。关于如何获取报警规则名称，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en:
The alert rule name.

- To create an alert rule for the application group, enter the alert rule name.

- To modify a specified alert rule in the application group, obtain the alert rule name. For information about how to obtain the alert rule name, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

description.zh:
通道沉默周期。

单位：秒。默认值：86400。
description.en:
The mute period during which CloudMonitor does not repeatedly send alert notifications for the same metric.

Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400.

description.zh:
报警发生回调时的URL地址。

填写公网可访问的URL地址，云监控会将报警信息通过POST请求推送到该地址，目前仅支持HTTP协议。
description.en:
The callback URL to which a request is sent when an alert is triggered.

Enter a URL that is accessible over the Internet. CloudMonitor sends a POST request to push alert information to this URL. Only the HTTP protocol is supported.

title.zh: 创建或修改指定应用分组中的报警规则
title.en: Create or modify an alert rule in a specified application group

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，为应用分组`17285****`中的云服务器ECS的监控项`cpu_total`创建一条报警规则，其中报警规则的ID为`123456`，报警规则名称为`Rule_test`，报警级别为`Critical`，报警统计方法为`Average`，报警阈值比较符为`GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`，报警阈值为`90`，报警重试次数为`3`。返回结果显示，创建报警规则成功，报警规则ID为`123456`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to create an alert rule for the `cpu_total` metric of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) in the application group `17285****`. The alert rule ID is `123456`, the alert rule name is `Rule_test`, the alert level is `Critical`, the statistical method is `Average`, the comparison operator is `GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold`, the threshold is `90`, and the retry count is `3`. The response shows that the alert rule is created. The alert rule ID is `123456`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-group-metric-rule --group-id 172850000 --rule-id 123456 --category ECS --rule-name Rule_01 --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric-name cpu_total --dimensions instanceId_:_i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr40000 --extra-dimension-json /dev/xvda_:_d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu0000 --effective-interval 05:31-23:59 --no-effective-interval 00:00-05:30 --silence-time 86400 --period 60 --interval 60 --webhook https://www.aliyun.com --email-subject ECS_instance --contact-groups ECS_Group --escalations-critical-statistics Average --escalations-critical-comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --escalations-critical-threshold 90 --escalations-critical-times 3 --escalations-warn-statistics Average --escalations-warn-comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --escalations-warn-threshold 90 --escalations-warn-times 3 --escalations-info-statistics Average --escalations-info-comparison-operator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --escalations-info-threshold 90 --escalations-info-times 3 --no-data-policy KEEP_LAST_STATE --labels Value=value1 Key=key1 --options NotSendOK_:true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutGroupMetricRule --region cn-hangzhou --NoEffectiveInterval '00:00-05:30' --Escalations.Critical.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --Options 'NotSendOK_:true' --Escalations.Info.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --Category ECS --RuleId 123456 --Escalations.Warn.Times 3 --Labels.1.Key key1 --Escalations.Info.Threshold 90 --MetricName cpu_total --Escalations.Warn.Statistics Average --Escalations.Warn.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --EmailSubject ECS_instance --RuleName Rule_01 --SilenceTime 86400 --ContactGroups ECS_Group --Escalations.Info.Times 3 --Labels.1.Value value1 --Escalations.Info.Statistics Average --Dimensions 'instanceId_:_i-m5e1qg6uo38rztr40000' --Period 60 --EffectiveInterval '05:31-23:59' --NoDataPolicy KEEP_LAST_STATE --Namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --GroupId 172850000 --Escalations.Critical.Statistics Average --Escalations.Warn.Threshold 90 --Escalations.Critical.Times 3 --ExtraDimensionJson '/dev/xvda_:_d-m5e6yphgzn3aprwu0000' --Webhook 'https://www.aliyun.com' --Escalations.Critical.Threshold 90 --Interval 60
